title: 3 things you can do to help your job search over the holidays
description:
3 things you can do to help your job search over the holidays

1 Resume update / clean up
2 Reach out on LinkedIn
3 Create job alerts for companies you're interested in

Do these things and you'll be ready to hit that new year job market hard! 

#jobsearchtips #jobsearch
transcript: right if you're not applying to any jobs over the holidays here's three things to do instead first thing is like a big winter spring cleaning get this thing like nice and top tier any old skills that maybe aren't relevant or old achievements that no longer are your best stuff get them out number two do a little networking reach out to like three people in your field connections or not and this isn't just like asking for a job here this is about building a relationship and third is creating a job alert for a company that you really want to work for in the jobs tab create job alert you give it the title that you're after location and work style and then keep an eye on that
